label: Unlinked readings from Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles
summary: I.12 [6]–[9]: The epistemic priority of sensible effects over prior knowledge of quiddity does not identify any one premise or warranted inference among the existing distinct causal routes. I.16 [7]: some being that is only in act and in no wise in potency: SCG I.16 concludes that a pure-act being exists. The current first-mover premises need this very first mover to be pure act, including every relevant respect. Bare existence does not identify the witness.
